operation: Keep the full original three native prefab hierarchies, transforms, component order, fields and managed state references. Remap real Windows scripts, serialized fonts/materials, original Wwise click PCM and cross-prefab references. Resolve the original SpriteAtlas render-data entry into each source Sprite, bake its original atlas UV transform into the UV stream and preserve source position/index bytes, logical rect, pivot, border, PPU and fractional trim offsets. Decode complete original ASTC atlas mip payloads to native RGBA32 Texture2D assets, preserving samplers and color space. GPU readback verifies every decoded mip and native Sprite fields; no integer-cropped sprite image substitutes the atlas. Native Sprite references remain type 2. Original popup clips and button controller retain the verified AssetRipper native data; derived incoming tangents allow only the documented one-float32-ULP decoder rounding difference.
